reviewFindings: Reviewed full scoped source diff, surrounding postJsonRpc implementation, and complete new test. HEAD source hash matches the brief baseline.

Gzip negotiation and streaming decoding preserve identity fallback, complete JSON settlement, fragmented UTF-8, single/batch results, and RPC error data. No retry, scheduler, source authority, Solver, Family, Rust, budget or config change is introduced by this slice.
Decoded accumulation uses Node MAX_STRING_LENGTH in JavaScript string units rather than a new smaller response-size or expansion-ratio policy.
Malformed gzip and unsupported encodings retain non-2xx HTTP status with null body; successful-status malformed bodies reject with sanitized errors.
Failure settlement precedes transport destruction, preventing synchronous aborted events from replacing the intended error. Cancellation remains attached until final settlement.
Cleanup always releases its decoder but avoids destroying a completed HTTP response/request, protecting a keep-alive socket already reused by another request.
Timing remains opt-in. responseBytes retains wire-body meaning; decodedResponseBytes and fixed-label contentEncoding do not expose URLs or payloads.

cases: HTTP 200 invalid gzip with response deliberately left open rejects invalid gzip, closes its owned socket, and emits exactly one timing settlement.
HTTP 429 invalid gzip with response deliberately left open preserves status 429/body null, closes its owned socket, and emits exactly one timing settlement.
Delayed invalid-gzip decoder failure after actual same-socket reuse rejects the old request without destroying the second held request; second request succeeds and old timing settles exactly once.

nonblockingCaveats: The late-decoder test uses threadpool work and a fixed short wait. It passed independently and explicitly requires both unfinished decode and actual socket identity; arbitrary host scheduling is not proven deterministic.
No external provider, same-input performance, full-Solver, or live result was produced by these offline implementation gates.
